newsitem.title: USA: International Post and Video approve merger.
newsitem.headline: International Post and Video approve merger.

text.p: International Post Ltd and privately held Video Serives Corp said Tuesday their directors had approved a previously announced merger.

Under the terms of the merger, IPL will issue about seven million shares of its common stock in exchange for 100 percent of the common stock of Video Services, the companies said in a joint statement.
The seven million share figure is about 250,000 shares higher than the number mentioned in the companies' executed letter of intent, they said.
They added that the deal is still pending on a definitive merger agreement and shareholder approval.
Video Services provides video services to customers through television networks and cable and syndicated programming markets.
IPL provides technical and creative services to owners and distributors of television porgramming.
